claims.scope: AtomWallet 77-byte signature validation and UserOperation time-window enforcement

preconditions.text: A relayer/bundler holds a valid 77-byte signed UserOperation for AtomWallet.; The last 12 bytes of the 77-byte signature encode validUntil and validAfter as metadata.; getUserOpHash hashes the UserOperation excluding the signature field.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: The validUntil/validAfter time window must be covered by the owner's signature so it cannot be altered without invalidating the signature.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The signer's intended time restriction is not enforced.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The relayer rewrites the last 12 bytes of userOp.signature before submission.
The submitted operation is presented for signature validation by AtomWallet.
The owner signature over userOpHash and the stripped 65-byte rawSignature remains valid after the suffix rewrite.

limitations: The window-authentication relation is encoded as grounded Boolean observables because the report omits numeric validUntil/validAfter definitions.
Only the i_window_not_enforced impact is formalized; stale execution and unauthorized actions are handled in separate passes.
